name: Majlis al-Shura
notes: Consultative Assembly of Saudi Arabia (150 appointed members; 9th session). Members are appointed by the King for four-year terms; there are no parties or factions, so the Seats tab shows the 150 seats as one block of appointed members, not a party split. The size follows the Shura Council Law and the member list on shura.gov.sa (read 2026-11-12). No supporter in the register sits in it today.
